opening.evidence: events/nomads_events_1.txt:3696-3770 hidden nomads.500 (needs origin_heirs_of_the_khan and marauder_heir) loops every 200+-100 days: 16 nothing, 5 spawn hunters (505 -> 506), 3 spawn a contract (common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt:5124-5272). nomads.545 (on_fleet_destroyed_perp common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1696) -> 546. nomads.605 on_entering_system_fleet common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1082; 610 / 615 on_space_battle_won common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1724-1725. The aspiring Khan itself is spawned by marauder.500 (events/marauder_events.txt:7361 -> nomads.600), see the Marauder stories.

label.zh: 击败野心可汗的两种情形
label.en: Two cases of beating the aspiring Khan

note.zh: 610：没有其他玩家竞争；615：另有未获胜的玩家，故自己成为“等待中的可汗”，3年后620“一步登天”，并通知对手（625）与上一位等待者（630）。
note.en: 610: no other player competes; 615: another player has not won yet, so you become the Khan in waiting, 620 follows after 3 years, and the others are told (625) and the previous waiting Khan loses (630) (events/nomads_events_1.txt:5245-5556).

note.zh: 上一位等待中的可汗输了，事件链结束。
note.en: The previous Khan in waiting loses; the chain ends.

note.zh: 成为大可汗（make_heirs_khan）或拒绝（750 分红）。
note.en: Become Great Khan (make_heirs_khan) or decline (dividend loop 750).

notes.zh: 选项a使玩家成为大可汗（make_heirs_khan；触发 marauder.501 / marauder.77 / timeline.130 等后续），选项b放弃，之后每720天经 nomads.750 获得“掠夺者红利”。这些后续窗口在通用的 Marauder 故事中。
notes.en: Option a makes the player Great Khan (make_heirs_khan; follow-ups marauder.501 / marauder.77 / timeline.130 live in the Marauder stories); option b declines and nomads.750 pays marauder dividends every 720 days (events/nomads_events_1.txt:5290-5330).

notes.zh: 猎手与委托（nomads.505、550、565、635、700 等）属于通用的游牧/掠夺者故事，由其他审阅范围负责；本起源仅保留其专属窗口。
notes.en: Hunter encounters and contracts (nomads.505, 550, 565, 635, 700 ...) belong to the generic Nomads / Marauder stories handled elsewhere; only the origin-specific windows are kept here.

uncertain: marauder.* follow-ups of becoming Khan are not part of this story; cross-links only.
Option-level conditions of 610 (Defender of the Galaxy / Custodian / Emperor restrictions) are read from source but not reproduced.
